onHit.manual: If the target is Large or smaller and the horse moved 20 or more feet straight toward it just before the hit, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition.

timeline.title: The old watchtower falls
timeline.text: A generation ago the watchtower north of the valley was abandoned. Its dead do not rest.

timeline.title: Goblins raid the east road
timeline.text: A goblin band with a tamed wolf took a merchant cart at dawn and camped east of the pond.

timeline.name: Mounted combat
timeline.text: Warhorse is Prone while Brenna rides Warhorse. Brenna makes a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or falls off, landing Prone within 5 ft of Warhorse (SRD "Falling Off"). Falling off is not in the engine yet: the DM has Brenna roll and, on a failure, sends dismount and the Prone condition.
